verdict.rationale: Weave's trace API host serves a complete, downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document at trace.wandb.ai/openapi.json covering 117 paths, plus Swagger UI and ReDoc views, and the Service API docs name this host as the base URL. The probe 404s were on docs.wandb.ai paths, a different host, so they do not contradict this. Missing for 10: the spec link listed in the docs llms.txt answers 404, so the spec is hard to discover from the docs, and no independent probe confirms the trace.wandb.ai spec directly.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: The Weave trace API host serves a complete machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document at the well-known path, covering the full service surface (117 paths, including /call/start and /calls/stream_query).
the working spec download is trace.wandb.ai/openapi.json.
The trace API hosts a live Swagger UI that loads /openapi.json
